pages.text: $(bold)Levers$() hold a state; $(bold)buttons$() give a short pulse (stone shorter than wood); $(bold)pressure plates$() fire when something stands on them. The whole manual-input family.
pages.title: By Hand

pages.text: $(bold)InfinityButtons$() adds the same wiring in disguise: a $(bold)Doorbell Button$() that chimes and emits a signal, a $(bold)Lantern Button$() that powers the chain above it, and $(bold)Redstone Torch$() buttons and levers that read as decoration but wire like the real thing.
pages.title: InfinityButtons
